whatChanged: NEW: SpaceX and Tesla merger talks are progressing, with a deal possibly announced as soon as December, per Bloomberg (tsla-spacex-merger)
NEW: easyJet shareholders approved Apollo's £5.7bn take-private with ~97% of voted shares in favour; only EU regulatory clearance remains (ezj-apollo-take-private)
NEW: H&R REIT unitholders voted down the C$6.7bn GO Residential/Blackstone-led breakup, and H&R called off the deal while GO sues for a C$102m termination fee (hr-un-go-residential-breakup)

ADVANCED: Banco BPM's board gave CEO Castagna a mandate to negotiate Crédit Agricole's merger proposal, saying terms must reflect the loss of BPM's takeover appeal (bami-credit-agricole-merger) (confirmed → confirmed)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep trying to take listed businesses off public markets, and shareholders keep deciding the outcome. easyJet holders approved Apollo's £5.7bn take-private (ezj-apollo-take-private), and CVC and GBL have crossed 90% of Recordati, clearing the way to delisting (rec-cvc-gbl-take-private). H&R REIT unitholders went the other way and voted down the C$6.7bn breakup led by GO Residential and Blackstone (hr-un-go-residential-breakup). HealthSpan raised its Surgery Partners price to $25 after a rival $28 approach (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). Silver Lake and PIF are in preliminary talks to take Unity private at about $25bn (u-silver-lake-pif-take-private), and LS Power has proposed a $2.00-a-share buyout of EVgo's public float (evgo-ls-power-take-private). Wendy's rejected Trian's $7.35 bid and adopted a poison pill (wen-trian-take-private), Helen of Troy rejected Empower Brands' $37 proposal (hele-empower-takeover-proposal), LCI rejected Monomoy's $101 approach (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal), and Challenger rejected TAL Daiichi Life's A$11.80 bid (cgf-tal-daiichi-takeover-proposal). AVID has matched Warburg Pincus again at A$5.55 for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal). Signed deals keep moving: Tata controls ~89% of Iveco (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer), Thrive Holdings is buying ADT with a go-shop to 28 November (adt-thrive-take-private), and Affle is delisting Perion (peri-affle-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators, courts and supervisors, not the parties, keep setting deal timelines. Consob has cleared Intesa's Monte dei Paschi offer document after ECB authorisation, leaving Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeeper (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal is expected to draw an in-depth US antitrust probe, with closing not before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition), Marvell's $115bn Lumentum deal is not expected to close until 2028 (mrvl-lumentum-acquisition), and Mitsui Chemicals' $11.6bn JSR purchase needs Japanese and foreign competition and investment approvals (4183-jsr-acquisition). easyJet's Apollo take-private now waits only on EU regulatory scrutiny (ezj-apollo-take-private). Western Union terminated its Intermex purchase after California's financial regulator imposed conditions it would not accept, with Intermex disputing the termination (wu-intermex-acquisition). JD.com could only close its Ceconomy takeover after EU merger-control, foreign-investment and foreign-subsidies clearances (jd-ceconomy-acquisition), and Hancock Whitney's Trustmark deal is timed around bank-regulator approval (hwc-trustmark-acquisition). The FTC and states have sued to block Cencora's $3.5bn sale of MWI Animal Health to Covetrus (cor-covetrus-mwi-divestiture), and GO Residential has taken H&R REIT to the Ontario Superior Court over a termination fee (hr-un-go-residential-breakup).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks and special payouts on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks and payouts. Costco declared a $30-a-share (~$13.3bn) special dividend alongside a new $4bn repurchase programme (cost-special-dividend-2026), Lam Research authorized a new open-ended $25bn programme, far above the ~$3.9bn it repurchased in fiscal 2026 (lrcx-buyback-2026), and Simpson Manufacturing replaced a $200m authorization with $1.0bn (ssd-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large chemicals groups, banks and grocers are buying rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. Banco BPM's board has opened talks on Crédit Agricole's proposal to merge its Italian arm into the bank, demanding terms that reflect the loss of BPM's takeover appeal (bami-credit-agricole-merger), and Intesa Sanpaolo's Monte dei Paschi offer opens on 24 November (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Evonik's board has refused to negotiate over BASF's €24-a-share approach, so RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake is the decisive lever (evk-basf-acquisition). Ahold Delhaize is buying Tesco's Czech and Slovak arm to make its Albert chain Czechia's market leader (ad-tesco-cz-sk-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas, refining and fuels companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. EQT agreed an all-stock deal for Range Resources to consolidate Appalachian gas (eqt-range-resources-acquisition), Ovintiv is buying Logan Energy to add Montney acreage (ovv-logan-energy-acquisition), Strathcona is folding in fellow Waterous-controlled oil sands producer Greenfire (scr-greenfire-acquisition), CVR Energy is buying Marathon Petroleum's two Upper Midwest refineries for ~$4.2bn (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition), and The Andersons is paying $915m for Harvestone's three ethanol plants (ande-harvestone-acquisition).
